segments.snp4.4:1.1: Passāmi suddhaṃ paramaṃ arogaṃ, diṭṭhena saṃsuddhi narassa hoti;
segments.snp4.4:1.3: Evābhijānaṃ [etābhijānaṃ (sī. pī.)] paramanti ñatvā, suddhānupassīti pacceti ñāṇaṃ.
segments.snp4.4:2.1: Diṭṭhena ce suddhi narassa hoti, ñāṇena vā so pajahāti dukkhaṃ;
segments.snp4.4:2.3: Aññena so sujjhati sopadhīko, diṭṭhī hi naṃ pāva tathā vadānaṃ.
segments.snp4.4:3.1: Na brāhmaṇo aññato suddhimāha, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā;
segments.snp4.4:3.3: Puññe ca pāpe ca anūpalitto, attañjaho nayidha pakubbamāno.
segments.snp4.4:4.1: Purimaṃ pahāya aparaṃ sitāse, ejānugā te na taranti saṅgaṃ;
segments.snp4.4:4.3: Te uggahāyanti nirassajanti, kapīva sākhaṃ pamuñcaṃ gahāyaṃ [pamukhaṃ gahāya (syā.), pamuñca gahāya (ka.)].
segments.snp4.4:5.1: Sayaṃ samādāya vatāni jantu, uccāvacaṃ gacchati saññasatto;
segments.snp4.4:5.3: Vidvā ca vedehi samecca dhammaṃ, na uccāvacaṃ gacchati bhūripañño.
segments.snp4.4:6.1: Sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā;
segments.snp4.4:6.3: Tameva dassiṃ vivaṭaṃ carantaṃ, kenīdha lokasmi vikappayeyya.
segments.snp4.4:7.1: Na kappayanti na purekkharonti, accantasuddhīti na te vadanti;
segments.snp4.4:7.3: Ādānaganthaṃ gathitaṃ visajja, āsaṃ na kubbanti kuhiñci loke.
segments.snp4.4:8.1: Sīmātigo brāhmaṇo tassa natthi, ñatvā va disvā va [ñatvā ca disvā ca (ka. sī. ka.)] samuggahītaṃ;
segments.snp4.4:8.3: Na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto, tassīdha natthī paramuggahītanti.

lines: Tattha paṭhamagāthāya tāvattho – na, bhikkhave, evarūpena dassanena suddhi hoti.

Apica kho kilesamalinattā asuddhaṃ, kilesarogānaṃ avigamā sarogameva candābhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ aññaṃ vā evarūpaṃ disvā diṭṭhigatiko bālo abhijānāti “passāmi suddhaṃ paramaṃ arogaṃ, tena ca diṭṭhisaṅkhātena dassanena saṃsuddhi narassa hotī”ti, so evaṃ abhijānanto taṃ dassanaṃ “paraman”ti ñatvā tasmiṃ dassane suddhānupassī samāno taṃ dassanaṃ “maggañāṇan”ti pacceti.
